mapper.select: SELECT id, type, name, status, phase, parent_id, path, updated_at, cpu, memory, restarts FROM resource WHERE type = 'CLUSTER' ORDER BY id
SELECT id, type, name, status, phase, parent_id, path, updated_at, cpu, memory, restarts FROM resource WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, type, name, status, phase, parent_id, path, updated_at, cpu, memory, restarts FROM resource WHERE name LIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') ORDER BY name LIMIT 50
SELECT id, type, name, status, phase, parent_id, path, updated_at, cpu, memory, restarts FROM resource WHERE path LIKE CONCAT(#{path}, '%') AND path <> #{path} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, type, name, status, phase, parent_id, path, updated_at, cpu, memory, restarts FROM resource WHERE updated_at > #{since} ORDER BY updated_at LIMIT 1000
SELECT id FROM resource WHERE type = #{type}
mapper.update: UPDATE resource SET status = #{status}, phase = #{phase}, restarts = #{restarts}, cpu = #{cpu}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND type = 'POD'
